rules.disclaimer: This is an analytical hypothesis derived from historical Bank of Canada policy patterns, not a prediction.
rules.methodology_note: Based on descriptive historical frequency of Bank of Canada rate responses to CPI readings above 3.5% over 2010-2024. Informational only; this is not a statistical forecast model.

branches.name: Accelerated Rate Response
branches.description: Historical pattern: CPI above 3.5% has often been followed by consecutive policy-tightening meetings. This branch represents the more frequent historical response pattern.

branches.name: Gradual Rate Response
branches.description: Historical pattern: the Bank of Canada may treat inflation pressure as partly transitory and respond with a single measured increase while monitoring later releases.

branches.name: Hold and Monitor
branches.description: Historical pattern: the Bank of Canada may hold the policy rate steady while citing transitory factors, uncertainty, or offsetting economic weakness.
